brief.prompt: Partnership proposal from Relay, a last-mile courier network, to Basket, a grocery delivery app.
brief.audience: Basket's VP of Operations and head of partnerships
brief.ask: Agree a 3-city pilot starting in January

outline.governing_thought: Relay's courier network can help Basket deliver groceries faster and more reliably, and a three-city pilot starting in January will prove it.
outline.audience: Basket's VP of Operations and head of partnerships
outline.ask: Agree a 3-city pilot starting in January
key_points: Basket's growth depends on reliable delivery windows
Relay adds flexible courier capacity without fixed cost
A small pilot proves the model before scaling
